caption: The drawing depicts a single, detailed bonnet in a pale blue-gray color, occupying the central part of the page against an off-white or cream background. The bonnet features a wide, rounded main section with a series of horizontal stitched bands and is adorned with a prominent, softly ruffled edge along the front opening. The back of the bonnet is gathered, creating a textured, voluminous effect. Two long, narrow ribbons extend from the lower sides, suggesting they are intended to be tied under the chin. There are no additional objects or decorations present, with all focus directed on the shape, folds, and delicate shading of the fabric in the bonnet.
title: Sun Bonnet
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
